criteria.criterion: Given a user opens GIS from the V4 launcher, then the GIS workspace loads with the map and available controls visible.
steps_taken: Observed the authenticated V4 GIS workspace already open.
Verified the GIS heading, layer groups, map canvas, map search field, map style control, zoom controls, and reset control were visible.
criteria.actual_result: GIS workspace loaded with the map and available controls visible.

criteria.criterion: Given a user searches for a known site or location, then the map moves to the selected result and shows it as the active location.
steps_taken: Observed the GIS state after the search attempt.
criteria.actual_result: The field retained London, but no selected result, map movement, active location, or search result was shown.
criteria.blocker: No search result or active-location state became available.

criteria.criterion: Given a visible map marker is selected, then a details panel opens for the same location and shows identifying information.
steps_taken: Inspected the post-search map state for a visible marker.
Did not select a marker because no visible marker was available.
criteria.actual_result: Testing could not proceed because no visible marker was present.
criteria.blocker: No visible map marker was available.

criteria.criterion: Given the details panel is closed, then the map remains at the selected location and GIS controls remain usable.
steps_taken: Inspected the post-search GIS state for a details panel.
Did not close a details panel because none opened.
criteria.actual_result: Testing could not proceed because no details panel was available to close.
